targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM runs;
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS success_rate FROM runs;
SELECT avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))) AS avg_seconds FROM runs WHERE status IN ('DONE','FAILED') AND ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED');
SELECT avg(attempts) AS avg_attempts FROM microtasks;

panels.title: First-Pass Yield

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts <= 1 AND status IN ('COMPLETED','DONE')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','DONE')),0),1) AS fpy FROM microtasks;

panels.description: Microtasks that passed the tester on the FIRST attempt (no reflector loop). Core autonomy-quality metric.

panels.title: Self-Correction Rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts > 1 AND status IN ('COMPLETED','DONE')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts > 1),0),1) AS rate FROM microtasks;

panels.description: Of microtasks that failed at least once, the % the coder↔tester↔reflector loop recovered to green.

panels.title: HITL Approval Rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload_json->>'decision'='approve') / NULLIF(count(*),0),1) AS approve_pct FROM events WHERE event_type='hitl.decided';

panels.description: Share of human gate decisions that APPROVED the agent's proposal (vs reject). High = the system needed little correction.

panels.title: Deploy Rate

targets.rawSql: WITH done AS (SELECT run_id FROM runs WHERE status='DONE'), pushed AS (SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM events WHERE event_type='gitops.pushed') SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM pushed)) / NULLIF(count(*),0),1) AS deploy_pct FROM done d;

panels.description: Of DONE runs, the % that actually pushed a branch (gitops.pushed) — end-to-end delivery.

panels.title: Cost per Successful Run

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM runs WHERE status='DONE'),0),4) AS cost FROM events WHERE event_type='llm.usage';

panels.description: Total spend divided by DONE runs — money per delivered outcome.

panels.title: Cost per Delivered Microtask

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM microtasks WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','DONE')),0),4) AS cost FROM events WHERE event_type='llm.usage';

panels.description: Total spend divided by completed microtasks — unit economics of shipped work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT run_id),0),2) AS avg_mt FROM microtasks;

panels.title: Plan Reviews per Run

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event_type='plan.reviewed')::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT count(DISTINCT run_id) FROM events WHERE event_type='plan.reviewed'),0),2) AS avg_reviews;

panels.description: Planner↔Reviewer actor-critic loop depth — reviews before a plan is approved.

panels.title: Verification Outcomes over Time (microtask checks)
panels.description: The grounded-verification loop: microtasks passing (green) vs failing (red) the tester each day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='microtask.completed') AS completed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='microtask.failed') AS failed FROM events WHERE event_type IN ('microtask.completed','microtask.failed') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Agent Division of Labor (tool calls)
panels.description: How the five agents share the work — sandbox/tool actions per role. Shows the MAS actually collaborating.

targets.rawSql: SELECT actor AS agent, count(*) AS tool_calls FROM events WHERE event_type='tool.executed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM runs GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT payload_json->>'agent' AS metric, sum((payload_json->>'total_tokens')::bigint) AS value FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage' AND payload_json->>'agent' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC;
SELECT status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM microtasks GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC;
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(run_name,''), left(run_id,8)) AS run, tokens_used_total FROM runs WHERE ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT created_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(run_name,''), left(run_id,8)) AS run, repo_url, status, llm_model AS model, tokens_used_total AS tokens, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))::int AS duration_s FROM runs WHERE ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Recovery Rate After Stall
panels.description: Of runs that emitted a run.stalled event, the % that still finished DONE.

targets.rawSql: WITH stalled AS (SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM events WHERE event_type = 'run.stalled') SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'DONE') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS recovery_pct FROM stalled s JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id;

panels.title: Reflections per Run
panels.description: Self-correction intensity — reflection.created events divided by total runs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'reflection.created')::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM runs), 0), 2) AS reflections_per_run;

panels.title: Token Efficiency
panels.description: Avg tokens spent per second of wall-clock, over terminal runs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(tokens_used_total / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)),0))::numeric,1) AS tokens_per_sec FROM runs WHERE status IN ('DONE','FAILED') AND updated_at > created_at AND ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED');

panels.title: Self-Corrected Microtasks
panels.description: Microtasks that failed at least once (attempts > 1) but ultimately completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS recovered FROM microtasks WHERE attempts > 1 AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'DONE');
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='DONE') AS "DONE", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='FAILED') AS "FAILED", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('DONE','FAILED')) AS "Other" FROM runs;
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS runs FROM runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Duration vs Tokens (correlation)
panels.description: Each dot = one terminal run. X = wall-clock seconds, Y = total tokens.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))::numeric,0) AS duration_s, tokens_used_total AS tokens FROM runs WHERE status IN ('DONE','FAILED') AND updated_at > created_at AND ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED') ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Task Description Length vs Duration
panels.description: Each dot = one terminal run. X = task_description chars, Y = wall-clock seconds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT length(task_description) AS desc_chars, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))::numeric,0) AS duration_s FROM runs WHERE task_description IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('DONE','FAILED') AND updated_at > created_at AND ('${include_failed}' = 'yes' OR status <> 'FAILED') ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Task Complexity — Length Bucket vs Duration / Success / Tokens

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN length(task_description) < 100 THEN '1. <100 chars' WHEN length(task_description) < 300 THEN '2. 100-300' WHEN length(task_description) < 600 THEN '3. 300-600' ELSE '4. 600+' END AS desc_bucket, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(length(task_description))) AS avg_chars, round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)))) AS avg_duration_s, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS success_pct, round(avg(tokens_used_total)) AS avg_tokens FROM runs WHERE task_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT llm_model AS model, count(*) AS runs, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS success_pct, round(avg(tokens_used_total)) AS avg_tokens, round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)))) AS avg_duration_s FROM runs WHERE llm_model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC;

panels.title: Lessons Memory Growth (per repo)
panels.description: Cross-run failure memory accumulated per repo (ADR 0018).

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo_url, count(*) AS lessons, count(DISTINCT run_id) AS from_runs FROM lessons GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY lessons DESC;

panels.title: Total Cost (priced models)
panels.description: USD across all runs. Cluster/unpriced models contribute tokens but no cost (like the per-run cost view's has_unpriced).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 2) AS total_usd FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage';
SELECT round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT run_id), 0), 4) AS avg_cost_per_run FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage';

SELECT payload_json->>'model' AS metric, round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 4) AS value FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage' AND payload_json->>'cost_usd' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Cost by Phase
panels.description: Which agent/phase spends the money — planner, coder, tester, reflector, plan_review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload_json->>'agent' AS metric, round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 4) AS value FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage' AND payload_json->>'cost_usd' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT payload_json->>'agent' AS phase, payload_json->>'model' AS model, SUM((payload_json->>'total_tokens')::bigint) AS tokens, round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 4) AS cost_usd FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST;
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, round(SUM((payload_json->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 4) AS cost_usd FROM events WHERE event_type = 'llm.usage' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
